blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
The nav menu is hidden by default. When a checkbox is checked the nav becomes visible. A label styled as a button is what the user actually taps.
The :checked selector is what makes this work. When the checkbox is checked the ~ selector reaches the nav menu and shows it. The label is what the user sees and taps.
Hit Run Code and narrow the window. Tap the ☰ and watch the nav open. Tap again and it closes.
You can see the nav dropping down when you tap the button and snapping into a row when you widen past 48rem.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
